tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: All countries Robert Makłowicz visited, with location and episode counts. Country names are in Polish.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: Episodes, newest first, optionally filtered to a country (Polish name, e.g. "Włochy").

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Search restaurants and attractions by text (name, address, description), country and/or type. Diacritics-insensitive. All data is in Polish, so use Polish names (e.g. "Zagrzeb", not "Zagreb").

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Full details of one location by id (from search_locations), including description and coordinates.
